evidence: Cic. Fam. 5.12: illī artificēs corporis simulācra ignōtīs nōta faciēbant (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Classically a master of one of the liberal arts, against opifex, a craftsman (Lewis & Short): painters, sculptors, musicians and actors (artificēs scaenicī). A painter in particular is pictor.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 164, 273.
